name: dsh-code
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin environment snapshot: local plugin sources + agent presets + pinned community plugin versions

localPlugins.name: dsh-memory-evolve
localPlugins.summary: 长期记忆与自我进化：五轨记忆(memory/user/project/key/daily)+记忆同步、dtodo 四轨待办、skill_manage 技能、de_canvas 无限画板、de_notify/de_channel_send 通知与渠道直发、内部会话团队、外部 CLI 代理调度、会话评审 Advisor

localPlugins.name: @dsh-external/dsh-graded-mode
localPlugins.summary: 分级模式：脑暴对齐 → commit_star 定稿北极星 → L1/L2 规格化计划 → 打卡制执行 → 红队裁决终验；6 个工具 commit_star/edit_plan/lock_stage/mark_task/redteam_verdict/revise_do；/graded <任务> 启动

localPlugins.name: @dsh-external/dsh-super-injector
localPlugins.summary: 运行时注入器：任意本地插件包免重启注入，host+client 双端生效，可热重载/卸载，侧挂(staging)工具转正，profile patch 与 link 依赖自愈，插件脚手架/构建/发布生产线（dev_* 工具全家桶）

localPlugins.name: only-memory
localPlugins.summary: 零依赖长期记忆（MCP）：sql.js(WASM) 本地落盘 + 纯 JS 向量检索；11 个 MCP 记忆工具（模型侧前缀 mcp__only_memory__）+ Web 管理界面 http://127.0.0.1:3456

registryPlugins.name: @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer
registryPlugins.summary: 技能中心 UI：按来源浏览/搜索/启停/创建/编辑/删除 SKILL.md

registryPlugins.name: @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams
registryPlugins.summary: 多 Agent 团队协作：队长 + 可续聊成员 + 带依赖任务 + 质量门禁 + Web DAG 监控

registryPlugins.name: billion-context
registryPlugins.summary: 上下文压缩：模型自主决策的增量可逆压缩，超长会话 + 少重发 token

registryPlugins.name: dsh-context
registryPlugins.summary: 上下文洞察面板：跨会话用量/成本概览、逐请求上下文构成追溯

registryPlugins.name: dsh-cost-meter
registryPlugins.summary: 会话费用统计：多厂商多模型计价、订阅额度、余额与峰谷提醒

registryPlugins.name: dshmarket
registryPlugins.summary: 可视化插件市场：社区目录浏览、一键安装/更新/卸载、主题与备份

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, modifying behavior, or planning anything new, in software or out of it (a talk, a business, a renovation).

skills.name: codex-cli-calling
skills.description: Use when the user wants to invoke Codex directly from a terminal without opening the interactive TUI, including one-shot tasks, repository edits, shell scripts, stdin pipelines, CI/automation, structured JSON output, or resuming a non-interactive session. Covers `codex exec`, working-directory and sandbox selection, output capture, JSONL/schema output, and safe automation. 触发场景：用户询问如何在 CLI/命令行里直接调用 Codex 做事、非交互执行任务、脚本或管道调用 Codex、让 Codex 自动修改项目、获取机器可读结果。

skills.name: diagnosing-superpowers
skills.description: Use when a superpowers session went wrong and your human partner wants to know why — repeated work, ignored plans, stumbles, poor results, a skill that didn't fire, "it took too long", "why is it so expensive", "what is it doing" — or wants to build a bug report for the superpowers maintainers, for the current session or a past one identified by id or path, on any harness.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work

skills.name: grok-cli-calling
skills.description: Use when the user wants to invoke the Grok CLI from the command line without entering the interactive TUI — one-shot quick queries, scripting/piping, non-interactive task execution, structured JSON output, or resuming a session. Covers `grok -p/--single` prompt mode, --output-format, --json-schema, -m model override, -c/--continue and -r/--resume, --permission-mode/--sandbox, and subcommands (agent, sessions, export, memory, mcp, plugin, doctor, login). 触发场景：用户在命令行直接让 Grok 干活、不进交互界面、快速一次性提问、写脚本调用、管道传参、非交互调用 grok。

skills.name: hermes-cli-calling
skills.description: Use when the user wants to invoke Hermes Agent from the command line without entering the interactive TUI — one-shot queries, scripting/piping, non-interactive task execution. Covers hermes chat -q / hermes -z, common flags (-Q, --max-turns, -t, -s, -m, --image, --yolo, -c/--resume), pipe usage, and alternative non-interactive surfaces (cron, send, proxy, acp). 触发场景:用户在命令行直接让 Hermes 干活、不进交互界面、写脚本调用、管道传参、定时任务。

skills.name: kimi-cli-calling
skills.description: Use when the user wants to invoke Kimi Code CLI from the command line without entering the interactive TUI — one-shot queries, scripting/piping, non-interactive task execution. Covers `kimi -p` prompt mode, --output-format, -m model override, -c/--session resume, --skills-dir/--agent/--add-dir/--plan, and subcommands (acp, web, export, login, doctor, vis, upgrade). 触发场景:用户在命令行直接让 Kimi 干活、不进交互界面、写脚本调用、管道传参、非交互调用 kimi。

skills.name: memory-consolidate
skills.description: Use when the user asks to consolidate, merge, deduplicate, or reorganize accumulated dsh-memory-evolve memories (global long-term memory, user profile, project key facts), or when a periodic memory review should run a full consolidation pass. Covers supersede-keep-newest, similar-entry merging, literal dedup, conflict resolution, project-local archiving, stale-state cleanup, and cross-track relocation, all with archive-based reversibility. 触发场景：用户要求梳理/合并/去重/整理记忆（长期记忆、用户档案、项目 key），记忆条目重复记录、新旧版本并存、表述相近却分散多条，或记忆审查到期需要一次系统性整合归档。

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

skills.name: using-superpowers
skills.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
